explanation: Generated EXCLURAD input for eta electroproduction at W=1.4885 GeV, Q2=0.5 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0.2, phi*=60 deg. Kinematically allowed: W=1.4885 GeV is 2.4 MeV above the eta production threshold (m_p+m_eta=1.48613 GeV) and within the EtaMAID-2023 table range (starts at W=1.4856 GeV). WARNING: This point is right at threshold, a known-risk kinematic regime. The README explicitly warns that near-threshold runs may trigger unphysical-skip detection (the codebase ships run_exclurad_skip_unphys.sh for exactly this case) and that radiative-correction results near threshold can be unreliable. The eta hadronic model (maid_lee, iphy=3) will be used with the 'maid07-PPpi.tbl' file which contains EtaMAID-2023 tables. Output files will be written to the current directory: all.dat, allu.dat, radasm.dat, radcor.dat, radsigmi.dat, radsigpl.dat, radtot.dat. Run with: ./build/exclurad.exe < input_eta_threshold.dat
